system.description:
Prerequisite: Level 5+ Warlock

While you're in an area of Dim or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.

Foundry Note

The Cast activity can be used in place of the Invisibility spell and includes an Active Effect that sets the Invisible status effect.

notes: not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
effect: invisible is not a WildPath condition yet
